name: Codeberg Forgejo API
tagline: REST API for Codeberg, a free Forgejo-powered Git hosting platform
description: Codeberg is a free, community-driven Git hosting service powered by Forgejo. It provides a Swagger-documented REST API for managing repositories, issues, pull requests, organizations, and user data—serving as a FOSS alternative to GitHub for open-source projects.

auth.details: Personal access token via Authorization: token YOUR_API_KEY header, or query parameter access_token. Self-serve signup at Codeberg; tokens created in user settings.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free for public/open-source use; Codeberg is donation-funded. No paid API plans for standard hosting.

rate_limits: not published (Forgejo/Gitea-style rate limiting may apply; check response headers)
use_cases: list repositories for a Codeberg user or org
create or update issues on a Codeberg repo
fetch pull request details and reviews
get authenticated user profile and settings
